pull_request.body:
## Experiment-only reviewer-context control

This Draft PR exists only to test whether an isolated Temporary Chat reviewer can discover semantic impact across changed and unchanged repository files when its repository evidence is delivered through a remote-verified whole-repository snapshot.

The control intentionally provides no expected finding, severity, category or semantic conclusion to the reviewer.

Expected structural property for the harness: the PR changes exactly one source file relative to the experiment base branch; related unchanged repository files remain available only through the whole-repository snapshot.

Do not merge this PR. It will be closed after the physical context experiment.
